content.text:
=== pnpm-workspace.yaml head ===
packages:
  - 'apps/*'
  - 'libs/*'
  - 'libs/*/*'
  - 'libs/*/*/*'
  - '!dist/**'
allowBuilds:
  '@firebase/util': true
  '@nestjs/core': true
  '@openapitools/openapi-generator-cli': true
  '@parcel/watcher': true
  '@swc/core': true
  esbuild: true
  less: true
  lmdb: true
  msgpackr-extract: true
  nx: true
  protobufjs: true
  # unrs-resolver (via @storybook/test-runner's jest-resolve) ships a prebuilt
  # napi binary, so its build script is not needed.
  unrs-resolver: false
  # cypress remains a transitive dependency (via @nx/cypress, pulled in by
  # @nx/web/@nx/angular) even though we migrated off Cypress to Playwright. Its
  # postinstall downloads the Cypress binary, which we do not want — explicitly
  # skip it so pnpm does not fail with ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS in CI.
  cypress: false
catalog:
  '@analogjs/vite-plugin-angular': '2.7.2'
  '@analogjs/vitest-angular': '2.7.2'
  '@angular-devkit/architect': '0.2201.8'
=== pnpm config ===
{
  "@jsr:registry": "https://npm.jsr.io/",
  "@sw-code:registry": "https://npm.pkg.github.com",
  "allowBuilds": {
    "@firebase/util": true,
    "@nestjs/core": true,
    "@openapitools/openapi-generator-cli": true,
    "@parcel/watcher": true,
    "@swc/core": true,
    "esbuild": true,
    "less": true,
    "lmdb": true,
    "msgpackr-extract": true,
    "nx": true,
    "protobufjs": true,
    "unrs-resolver": false,
    "cypress": false
  },
  "catalog": {
    "@analogjs/vite-plugin-angular": "2.7.2",
    "@analogjs/vitest-angular": "2.7.2",
    "@angular-devkit/architect": "0.2201.8",
    "@angular-devkit/core": "22.1.8",
    "@angular-devkit/schematics": "22.1.8",
    "@angular/animations": "22.1.6",
    "@angular/aria": "22.1.6",
    "@angular/build": "22.1.8",
    "@angular/cdk": "22.1.6",
    "@angular/cli": "22.1.8",
    "@angular/common": "22.1.6",

observation.command: grep -rn "minimumReleaseAge\|minimum-release-age" /workspace/app/pnpm-workspace.yaml /workspace/app/.npmrc /workspace/pnpm-workspace.yaml 2>/dev/null; echo "=== pnpm-workspace.yaml head ==="; head -30 /workspace/app/pnpm-workspace.yaml 2>/dev/null; echo "=== pnpm config ==="; cd /workspace/app && pnpm config list 2>/dev/null | head -30
